summary: Implemented the Tabs feature but did not run any tests, as instructed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, private TabsRenderable, Tabs widget); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (fourth input, width now fifth) and returns one Text with click spans appended last; Opacity now merges blended color into the existing style via style + blended so @click meta is preserved; new docs/reference/tabs.md; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/test_tabs.py. Layout resolver unchanged because Edge already had size, min_size, and fraction. Decisions: bar position uses displayed-tab indices (converted from find_tab_by_name) so duplicates still place the underline under the active tab; keyboard search only applies to single-character keys; zero-width label edges are omitted from the resolver call; names containing ')' cannot be parsed by the existing action regex. Sandbox demo skipped as optional. Nothing committed. Test results are unverified.
